facts.fact: Approximately 88% of US households own at least one internet-connected TV device, according to the vendor's blog post.
The vendor states that CTV now accounts for over one-third of total TV usage.
facts.quote: CTV now accounts for over one-third of total TV usage

facts.fact: The vendor cites projections indicating CTV will surpass linear TV in reach in 2024.
facts.quote: with projections indicating it will surpass linear TV in reach in 2024

facts.fact: By 2025, an estimated 62.6 million millennials in the US will watch CTV, per the vendor's post.
By 2025, an estimated 56.1 million Gen Zers in the US will watch CTV, per the vendor's post.
The Super Bowl game itself runs three to four hours, according to the post.
facts.quote: the three- to four-hour game itself

facts.fact: CTV does not yet have a universally accepted framework for measuring reach, frequency, and performance, unlike linear TV, which relies on long-established rating systems.
facts.quote: Unlike linear TV, which relies on long-established rating systems, CTV does not yet have a universally accepted framework for measuring reach, frequency, and performance.

facts.fact: The CTV landscape is fragmented across multiple platforms, devices, and content providers, which often results in siloed data where advertisers see performance only within individual platforms.
facts.quote: This fragmentation often results in siloed data, where advertisers can only see performance within individual platforms rather than across the entire campaign.

facts.fact: The article says emerging solutions such as multi-platform attribution models and data-sharing agreements are helping bridge gaps between CTV and other media channels.
facts.quote: Emerging solutions, such as multi-platform attribution models and data-sharing agreements, are helping bridge the gaps between CTV and other media channels.

facts.fact: StackAdapt, the vendor, states that its CTV inventory lets brands run targeted campaigns around the Super Bowl.
facts.quote: With StackAdapt’s CTV inventory, your brand can tap into the excitement, deliver targeted campaigns, and drive real results—before, during, and after the big game.
